ModMetaData.name: RimVision – Third Person
ModMetaData.author: Papaya
ModMetaData.description:
Adds an over-the-shoulder camera to RimVision using its public API 1.5.
Enter RimVision with O, then control a colonist with V. K switches between first-person and third-person cameras. Use the mouse wheel to adjust the camera distance. WASD, aiming and interactions keep their RimVision bindings. The toggle can be rebound in RimVision's controls settings.
The camera shortens its distance near obstacles and keeps aiming from the actor. Mortar targeting, falls and camera transitions use RimVision's normal camera.
Requires RimVision with API 1.5 or newer. Load after RimVision. Multiplayer also requires the matching RimVision Multiplayer Compatibility add-on.
Камера за плечом для RimVision. O – открыть 3D, V – управление персонажем, K – первое/третье лицо, колесо мыши – расстояние. Клавишу можно изменить в настройках управления RimVision.
